tool_usage_monthly.notes: High use in variance memo and meeting recap workflows.

persona_productivity.notes: Screening summary use is high; scheduling still constrains cycle time.
Higher req load appears sustainable for corporate roles.
Commentary drafts reduce first-pass effort; reconciliations still manual.
Close compression is early and not yet fully attributable to AI.
Improvement seen across digital banking repos.
Now Assist helps summarization, less on true auto-resolution.
No production uplift claim until model validation evidence improves.

servicenow_ai_agents.notes: Summarization adopted; auto-resolution still below target.

Low deflection; workflow automation gaps remain.

AI touch is low and exception rate worsened slightly.

risk_governance.risk_description: Copilot output may include sensitive client data in uncontrolled summaries.
Developer AI tools may expose secrets or regulated logic through prompts.
ServiceNow agent handoff quality varies by queue.
Workday AI-agent data-use terms need procurement/legal confirmation.
Oracle variance commentary lacks enough source traceability for controller sign-off.
Credit decisioning model cannot scale until SR 11-7 validation package is approved.
AI governance operating model ownership unresolved between CIO and CDO.
